name: Tsunagari Chess School
source:
Hi, I'm Yumiko!
In charge of admin matters here at Sakugari chess school~ 🌸

I'm pleased to welcome you! It is my ambition to share the beauty of chess with you, knowledge of chess is not required, so don't worry!

We’ll pair you with the other girls during class to help you level up your game!

Oh, and we also host fun events outside of class, so there’s always something to look forward to!

I can't wait to meet you in person! Let’s make lots of great memories together! ❤️
translation:
嗨，我是由美子！
负责作作象棋学校的行政事务~

我很高兴欢迎你！与大家分享国际象棋之美是我的愿望，不需要国际象棋知识，所以不用担心！

我们将在课堂上将你与其他女孩配对，以帮助你提高游戏水平！

哦，我们还在课外举办有趣的活动，所以总有一些值得期待的事情！

我迫不及待地想见到你本人！让我们一起留下很多美好的回忆吧！❤️
